idea-plugin.name: DTO Generator Fields
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for @Fields and @FieldPath from com.tabariyya:java-dto-generator.
  • Resolves the public static final String constants the annotation processor injects into @Fields classes, so the IDE sees them the way javac does.
  • Reports a wrong or non-existent field path in an annotation argument as you type, with the same message the compiler would print.
